t: 拉克兰·麦格理少将正式就任新南威尔士州州长。

dz: 拉克兰·麦格理少将正式就任新南威尔士州州长。

te: Britain seizes Guadeloupe.
dz: 拿破仑战争:英国夺取瓜德罗普.

te: Siege of Cádiz begins.
dz: 半岛之战:Cádiz围攻开始.

t: 总督维森特·恩帕兰 (Vicente Emparán) 被加拉加斯人民罢免，并成立了军政府。
te: Vicente Emparán, Governor of the Captaincy General is removed by the people of Caracas and a junta is installed.
dz: 委内瑞拉实现地方自治：总督维森特·恩帕兰 (Vicente Emparán) 被加拉加斯人民罢免，并成立了军政府。
de: Venezuela achieves home rule: Vicente Emparán, Governor of the Captaincy General is removed by the people of Caracas and a junta is installed.

de: May Revolution: Citizens of Buenos Aires expel Viceroy Baltasar Hidalgo de Cisneros during the "May Week", starting the Argentine War of Independence.

dz: "Gazeta de Buenos Ayres"报纸最早在阿根廷出版.

te: John Jacob Astor forms the Pacific Fur Company.
dz: 约翰·雅各布·阿斯特 (John Jacob Astor) 成立了太平洋毛皮公司。

dz: 拿破仑吞并荷兰王国，成为法兰西第一帝国的一部分。
de: Napoleon annexes the Kingdom of Holland as part of the First French Empire.

dz: 新格拉纳达波哥大公民宣布脱离西班牙独立。

te: Napoleon annexes Westphalia as part of the First French Empire.
dz: 拿破仑将威斯特伐利亚吞并为法兰西第一帝国的一部分。

te: Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte, Marshal of France, is elected Crown Prince of Sweden by the Swedish Riksdag of the Estates.
dz: 让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特(法语:Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte)是法国元帅,被"地产"的瑞典议会选举为瑞典王储.
de: Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte, Marshal of France, is elected Crown Prince of Sweden by the Swedish Riksdag of the Estates.

dz: 普拉塔河畔里奥(英语:Río de la Plata)的总督圣地亚哥·德·利尼尔斯(英语:Santiago de Liniers)在反革命失败后被处决.
de: The former viceroy Santiago de Liniers of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata is executed after the defeat of his counter-revolution.

t: 法国海军击败英国皇家海军，阻止他们占领法兰西岛大港的港口。
te: The French Navy defeats the British Royal Navy, preventing them from taking the harbour of Grand Port on Île de France.
dz: 拿破仑战争：法国海军击败英国皇家海军，阻止他们占领法兰西岛大港的港口。
de: Napoleonic Wars: The French Navy defeats the British Royal Navy, preventing them from taking the harbour of Grand Port on Île de France.

te: The French Navy accepts the surrender of a British Royal Navy fleet at the Battle of Grand Port.
dz: 拿破仑战争：法国海军在大港战役中接受英国皇家海军舰队的投降。
de: Napoleonic Wars: The French Navy accepts the surrender of a British Royal Navy fleet at the Battle of Grand Port.

te: The Tonquin sets sail from New York Harbor with 33 employees of John Jacob Astor's newly created Pacific Fur Company on…
dz: 通昆号从纽约港起航,船上有约翰·雅各布·阿斯特(John Jacob Astor)新成立的太平洋富尔公司的33名员工.
de: The Tonquin sets sail from New York Harbor with 33 employees of John Jacob Astor's newly created Pacific Fur Company on board.

t: 与"格利托·德多洛斯"(Grito de Dolores)一起,米格尔·伊达尔戈神父开始了墨西…
te: With the Grito de Dolores, Father Miguel Hidalgo begins Mexico's fight for independence from Spain.
dz: 与"格利托·德多洛斯"(Grito de Dolores)一起,米格尔·伊达尔戈神父开始了墨西哥从西班牙独立的斗争.
de: With the Grito de Dolores, Father Miguel Hidalgo begins Mexico's fight for independence from Spain.

t: 智利第一政府军。 虽然它本应只在西班牙半岛战争期间统治,但事实上它是从西班牙独立的第一步,并因…
te: First Government Junta in Chile. Though supposed to rule only during the Peninsular War in Spain, it is in fact the fir…
dz: 智利第一政府军。 虽然它本应只在西班牙半岛战争期间统治,但事实上它是从西班牙独立的第一步,并因此被纪念.
de: First Government Junta in Chile. Though supposed to rule only during the Peninsular War in Spain, it is in fact the first step towards independence from Spain, and is commemorated as such.

t: 新继承法由庄园议会通过,让·巴蒂斯特·贝纳多特成为瑞典王位继承人.
te: A new Act of Succession is adopted by the Riksdag of the Estates, and Jean Baptiste Bernadotte becomes heir to the Swed…
dz: 新继承法由庄园议会通过,让·巴蒂斯特·贝纳多特成为瑞典王位继承人.
de: A new Act of Succession is adopted by the Riksdag of the Estates, and Jean Baptiste Bernadotte becomes heir to the Swedish throne.

t: 安德烈·马塞纳手下的法军在布萨克战役中未能击溃亚瑟·韦尔斯利(英语:Arthur Welles…
te: The French army under André Masséna fails to break British forces under the Arthur Wellesley in the battle of Bussaco.
dz: 安德烈·马塞纳手下的法军在布萨克战役中未能击溃亚瑟·韦尔斯利(英语:Arthur Wellesley)手下的英军.

dz: 一场大火摧毁了芬兰大公国Raahe镇所有建筑的三分之一.

dz: 瑞典向盟国宣战 英国开始英德战争 尽管从未发生过战斗.
